scientific_integrity: Analytic proof provided; finite exact checks are supplementary only; independently validated by no external party.
scientific_limitations: Lower bounds, not exact point eigenvalues or a matching counting upper bound; applies only to binomial analytic symbols on standard beta-weighted analytic Bergman spaces. The earlier Jacobi literature creates a risk of an equivalent qualitative implication.
title: Coulomb-edge eigenvalue cascades for binomial Bergman multiplier Gram operators
